function.description: Search for or look up one or more SPECIFIC Solana tokens you can already name — by symbol, name, or mint address (up to 100 comma-separated mints for a batch lookup) — for identity, price, market cap, liquidity, holder count, and safety-audit flags. Use solana.tokens.trending instead when you don't have a name yet and want to discover new, popular, or top-moving tokens.
function.name: solana__tokens_search

minLiquidity.description: Only include tokens with liquidity (USD) >= this value. Rejected if negative.

minOrganicScore.description: Only include tokens with organicScore >= this value (0-100). Rejected if out of range.

query.description: Token name, symbol, or mint address. Accepts a comma-separated list of mint addresses (up to 100) for batch lookup.

statsInterval.description: Which stats window to include per token: 5m, 1h, 6h, or 24h, or all for every window (default: 1h).
